/*selectMasterMpRqKepStndrdCategorySelPopList*/ SELECT A.CMS_CATEG_ID, A.CATEG_NAME, A.CATEG_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMSCATTR T WHERE T.CMS_CATEG_ID = A.CMS_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, DECODE(A.CATEG_TYPE,'REG','0', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSCATLG X WHERE X.CMS_CATEG_ID = A.CMS_CATEG_ID)) AS CNT, A.CATEG_PATH, NVL(A.DESCRIPT,' ') AS DESCRIPT
, A.SG_ID , (SELECT X.SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG X WHERE X.SG_ID = A.SG_ID AND ROWNUM =1) AS SG_NAME
FROM CMSCATEG A WHERE A.DEPTH = #{param2} AND A.STATUS <> 'D'
AND A.PID = #{param3}
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,8) FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID = #{st_sour_sg_id} AND B.STATUS != 'D' )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,12) FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID = #{st_sour_sg_id} AND B.STATUS != 'D' )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,16) FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID = #{st_sour_sg_id} AND B.STATUS != 'D' )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT B.CATEG_SYS_ID FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID = #{st_sour_sg_id} AND B.STATUS != 'D' )
ORDER BY A.CATEG_SYS_ID

/*selectCategorySelPop*/ SELECT /*+INDEX(A SYS_C0051918)*/ DISTINCT B.CMS_CATEG_ID, B.CATEG_NAME, B.CATEG_TYPE, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CMSCATTR T WHERE T.CMS_CATEG_ID = B.CMS_CATEG_ID), 0,'N','Y') AS MASTER_CHECK, DECODE(B.CATEG_TYPE,'REG','0', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT X.CMS_CATLG_ID) FROM CMSCATLG X WHERE X.CMS_CATEG_ID = B.CMS_CATEG_ID)) AS CNT, B.CATEG_PATH, B.CATEG_SYS_ID
, B.SG_ID , (SELECT X.SG_NAME FROM KEPSGMG X WHERE X.SG_ID = B.SG_ID AND ROWNUM =1) AS SG_NAME
FROM CMSCATEG A, CMSCATEG B WHERE B.DEPTH = #{param2}
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,8) = B.CATEG_SYS_ID
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,12) = B.CATEG_SYS_ID
AND SUBSTR(A.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,16) = B.CATEG_SYS_ID
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID = B.CATEG_SYS_ID
AND A.CATEG_NAME LIKE '%' || #{param3} || '%'
AND A.CMS_CATEG_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT Y.CMS_CATEG_ID FROM CMSCATLG Y WHERE ( CONTAINS(Y.DESCRIPTION_LOC,'%'||#{param4}||'%' ) > 0 OR CONTAINS(Y.SPECIFICATION,'%'||#{param4}||'%' ) > 0) )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,8) FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID IN ( SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' ) )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,12) FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID IN ( SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' ) )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_ID,0,16) FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID IN ( SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' ) )
AND A.CATEG_SYS_ID IN ( SELECT B.CATEG_SYS_ID FROM CMSCATEG B WHERE B.CATEG_TYPE ='ITM' AND B.SG_ID IN ( SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT C.CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 C WHERE C.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND C.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND C.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y' ) )
AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY B.CATEG_SYS_ID
